# OTNO Access Solutions

> OTNO Access Solutions is a Kenyan height-safety company providing rope access, scaffolding, mobile access platforms, and netting & decking services for commercial and industrial projects across Kenya and East Africa.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of OTNO's height-safety services and featured projects.
- [About](/about): Company background, safety philosophy, and operating coverage.
- [Services](/services): Full list of height-safety services offered.
- [Rope Access](/services/rope-access): Certified rope-access technicians for inspection and maintenance at height.
- [Scaffolding](/services/scaffolding): Scaffolding design, erection, hire, and compliance.
- [Mobile Access Platforms](/services/mobile-access): EWP and boom lift hire with operator support.
- [Netting & Decking](/services/netting-decking): Safety netting, edge protection, and temporary decking.
- [Work](/work): Selected past projects across Kenya.
- [Catalogue](/catalogue): Equipment catalogue.
- [Contact](/contact): Contact details and project enquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy): How OTNO collects, uses, and protects visitor information.
